title: Elixirs Armor Stands
description: Armor stand with arms and the ability to change they're poses
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93e682dbdfd8b2f9231bb3a53e127cac1c5f2ea6.png)

![INTRODUCTION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/577cdec2c518b4d453b7798450789dff2b66c107.png)
## What does Elixirs Armor Stands Datapack do?
It gives you the ability to craft armor stand with arms and **lets you change armor stand poses by crouch right clicking the bottom of the armor stand**
![positions](https://i.imgur.com/l3iwBov.gif)


![RECIPE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b71b974523259e97482599302263cc20470d584.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7ba75e0cf5cc545c0bc9e3ae594f77878649253.png)

![UNINSTALLATION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c0fbcadc887c79142f2acf3076cd8fa7184ba13.png)
to uninstall the datapack use this function:
```
/function armor-stand-with-arms:uninstall
```
then you can just remove the datapack from the datapack folder
